column1: # Hades II (Supergiant Games' engine on NVN), base game v0 (the NACP's display version 0.0.126424, SDK 19.3.9) and update v655360 (1.0.141667, SDK 20.5.15).
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; values marked "Mario's" are not measured for this game yet.
# Unlike Hades (Vulkan), the Switch version renders with NVN: its 88 shaders are BNSH files in Shaders/NVN/bin (.vert / .frag; the .shader files list each program's pair).
# The ExeFS has only main and sdk. main's EOS_* imports (Epic Online Services, from nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro, loaded through nn::ro) stay offline: the host
# registers no NRR, so the game never loads the NRO.
# the right stick aims (the weapons with ManualAiming in Game/Weapons/PlayerWeapons.sjson)
# The shader tables are v0's and stay so: the update's 55 shaders all have keys among v0's 88 (its shader split gave a subset of v0's map and no facts, pairs or bf_want rows),
# so v0's tables are already the union of both, and packing either version needs only what the folder always holds
# The render size stub (patches.py) scales the game's 1280x720, the same docked and handheld, by DM_RENDER_SCALE up to 3.0: the launcher shows the size in pixels
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. It asks for 3.10 GB (pool − used memory), which the 3.25 GB heap region of
# the 4 GB layout holds. main carries an 82 MB bss: the rewritten modules take more than the default 64 MB of used memory, so SetHeapSize(pool − 64 MB) would not fit
